svg.text: A5 bid programme - Gantt - ADD-02 - planning date 2026-10-22 (PROPOSAL, not reviewed)

Earliest dates: forward pass from 2026-10-22 (first Working Day on or after the planning date, the ADD-02 issue date). Latest dates: backward pass from the pack deadlines. Working Days Sun-Thu (VOL-I 2.4). Every duration, effort, waiting party and capacity is a PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTION (config/assumptions.yaml).
Attendance-notice window ends (conditional) 14 Oct (conservative; 15 Oct if the ADD-01 issue day is excluded)
PDD 14:00 / ISO current as at / Withdraw/modify cut-off / Omission claims cut-off 26 Nov

PROPOSAL, not reviewed. Timing, decision readiness and resource feasibility are separate statuses; resource levelling is NOT implemented; overloads are reported, not resolved. No bidder references, certificates, attendance or financial standing are assumed to exist.

Each row: activity id, count, then the A1 requirement ids that fit (+n more); ALL ids are in the row's hover title, gantt.html and programme.csv. Load window: late (LS..LF, clipped at the planning date).

Milestones outside the chart: Reference look-back start 2016-11-27 (conservative; 2016-11-26 if the boundary day counts); Blackout start 2026-09-14; Proposal validity end 2027-04-25 (conservative; 2027-04-24 if the PDD counts as day 1); Bid bond validity end 2027-05-25 (conservative; 2027-05-24 if the PDD counts as day 1).
